## HAPI v0.25.3.4

### Compared with the previous maintained release

Hotfix for hubs that ran `swear01/hapi` `v0.25.1.1` before the official scratchlist attachments migration. That build spent schema V15 on `sessions.personality`, so later `0.25.3.x` bumps to schema 16 never added `session_scratchlist.attachments` and `scratchlist.list` / export failed. Opening the hub DB now idempotently adds the missing column even when `user_version` is already 15 or 16.

### Compared with the official release

Same maintained overlay as `v0.25.3.3`, plus the fork-polluted schema repair above. Official `tiann/hapi` upgrades that never touched `v0.25.1.1` do not need this path; V14→V15 already adds `attachments` there.

### Maintained-fork guarantees

Release tags are published only from commits contained in `main`; macOS artifacts retain the `xyz.hapi.cli` signing identity; app-shell cache headers remain no-store; and PR #1320 (Antigravity) is excluded.
